behavior: Given the fixture's multi-module Maven reactor (an outer pom.xml declaring <modules>, each module with its own pom.xml, and a source file nested inside each module), resolving any path within the reactor -- the reactor root itself, a module directory, or a source file nested inside a module -- always returns the outer reactor root as the workspace id, never an individual module's own pom.xml directory.
rationale: Deriving the workspace id from a path branches on nearest ancestor pom.xml, then whether that pom is a <modules> member of a further-out reactor pom -- a decision table's row-per-combination fits [INV-ROUTE-3]; rows at reactor root, each module dir, and a nested module file directly falsify an implementation that stops at the nearest ancestor pom.xml instead of continuing up to the reactor root -- the JDT LS multi-root weakness (issue 1303, evidence.md) this component exists to avoid.
